baseline.typecheck: No typecheck script; tsc polluted by vitest html/; src hit: unused ids

issues.title: Missing order crashes processOrder with a 500
issues.evidence: findFirst is force-unwrapped with `!`. A missing id yields undefined; destructuring throws TypeError → HTTP 500. z.coerce.number() also accepts negatives/non-integers.
issues.remediation: Return 404 when the order is absent. Constrain orderId to a positive integer in the Zod params schema.
issues.prevention: Integration test: unknown orderId returns 404 and leaves every product row unchanged; non-integer param → 400.

issues.title: Multi-product stock updates are non-atomic and lose increments under concurrency
issues.evidence: Read-modify-write of absolute available with no transaction around the product loop. Concurrent processOrder can oversell; a mid-loop throw leaves earlier lines committed.
issues.remediation: One DB transaction per processOrder. Prefer conditional decrement (affected-row count). Roll back the whole order on any line failure.
issues.prevention: Integration: forced failure on second product restores first product stock; concurrent available=1 ends at 0 with one success.

issues.title: Expirable out-of-stock products are treated as expired
issues.evidence: Controller calls handleExpiredProduct whenever sellable check fails. Service else-branch always sends expiration notification and zeros stock — including available=0 with future expiryDate. Cahier: expiration notification after expiry; OOS while unexpired should follow delay rule.
issues.remediation: Branch on expiry first in one place: expired → expiration notify + unavailable; unexpired in stock → decrement; unexpired OOS → notifyDelay. Remove duplicated predicate.
issues.prevention: Unit cases: future expiry + stock → decrement; future expiry + OOS → delay only; past expiry → expiration + available 0.

issues.title: Seasonal rules disagree with the cahier and can wipe on-hand stock
issues.evidence: Before season / after season, handleSeasonalProduct can take leadTime-vs-seasonEnd first and set available=0, discarding stock. Cahier: before season → unavailable notify; delay-vs-season-end when OOS during season.
issues.remediation: Centralize seasonal policy in ProductService: sell in season with stock; before start → out-of-stock notify, leave available; in-season OOS → delay or out-of-stock by leadTime vs season end; after end → unavailable without wiping on-hand unless explicitly approved.
issues.prevention: Unit matrix covering in/out season, OOS short/long lead, before start, after end with remaining stock.

issues.title: Normal out-of-stock with leadTime <= 0 notifies nobody
issues.evidence: Delay notification only if leadTime > 0. leadTime 0 skips client announcement while still returning 200.
issues.remediation: Always call notifyDelay on NORMAL OOS; treat negative leadTime as a domain error.
issues.prevention: Unit: available=0, leadTime=0 → sendDelayNotification(0, name).

issues.title: Unknown product type is skipped and the order still returns 200
issues.evidence: type is unconstrained text; switch has no default and exhaustiveness is disabled. Unknown type is a silent no-op with 200.
issues.remediation: Closed union NORMAL|SEASONAL|EXPIRABLE; fail and roll back order on unknown type; remove exhaustiveness disable.
issues.prevention: Integration: type UNKNOWN → error status, no available changes.

issues.title: Processing the same order twice decrements stock again
issues.evidence: orders has only id; no processed flag. Retry of same orderId sells again.
issues.remediation: Persist processed state on the order inside the same transaction; second call returns existing result without decrement/notify.
issues.prevention: Integration: two processOrder calls → available moved by one unit total; notifications once.

issues.title: Stock and notification paths write the full product row, including id
issues.evidence: Every update is `.set(p)` rewriting the whole selected row (including id), amplifying stale read-modify-write races.
issues.remediation: Update only changed columns (available, and leadTime when needed); keep primary key in WHERE only.
issues.prevention: Unit: delay notification leaves name/type/dates unchanged; assert update payload columns.

issues.title: Season and expiry dates are force-unwrapped and null is treated as the epoch
issues.evidence: Nullable dates with `!` assertions; null coerces to epoch in comparisons → seasonal/expirable misclassified as OOS/expired and may zero stock.
issues.remediation: Require season dates for SEASONAL and expiryDate for EXPIRABLE; fail order with domain error if missing.
issues.prevention: Unit tests with null dates expect error and unchanged available.

issues.title: Unit test WHERE clause always matches the first product row
issues.evidence: `eq(product.id, product.id)` shadows the fixture; predicate always true. Green with a single row but does not prove correct id persistence.
issues.remediation: Filter by inserted id via schema column; assert that row's fields.
issues.prevention: Insert a second product so a tautology fails.

issues.title: Integration test never checks stock or notifications
issues.evidence: Six-product cahier fixture exists but test only asserts HTTP 200 and order id presence. Passes even if stock logic is removed.
issues.remediation: Assert each product's available and exact notification calls after processOrder.
issues.prevention: Map each fixture row to an expected outcome; fail if fixture grows without expectations.

issues.title: Unauthenticated processOrder is bound on all interfaces
issues.evidence: No auth/authorization on stock-changing POST; listen host 0.0.0.0. Anyone who can reach the port can mutate inventory.
issues.remediation: Gate 1 decision: defer auth for local kata OR require credential before stock writes; bind loopback in non-prod if deferred.
issues.prevention: Config/test that listen host is loopback unless explicit env opts into exposure; auth rejection test once in scope.

issues.title: pnpm audit reports critical and high advisories
issues.evidence: pnpm audit: ~8 critical / ~56 high among 119. Runtime notables: convict, pinned fastify 4.25.2, drizzle-orm; unused lodash; vitest UI/API critical when exposed.
issues.remediation: Upgrade direct runtime packages (fastify, convict, drizzle-orm); remove unused lodash; do not expose vitest --ui; re-audit.
issues.prevention: Add audit script + CI failing on critical/high production deps.

issues.title: Sell rules live in the controller and are duplicated in ProductService
issues.evidence: Controller owns NORMAL/SEASONAL/EXPIRABLE decisions, decrements, and SQL. Service only sees failure branches but also duplicates sell/season logic (drives ISSUE-003/004).
issues.remediation: Controller loads order + maps HTTP; ProductService owns availability/notifications/persistence. Keep INotificationService unchanged (WARN).
issues.prevention: Review check: controller must not import drizzle product updates or switch on product.type.

issues.title: Product invariants and foreign keys are not enforced by the schema
issues.evidence: Free-text type; nullable type-specific dates; no processed state; SQLite foreign_keys not enabled on connection.
issues.remediation: Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys; application/schema guards for type-specific dates; add processed column with idempotency work.
issues.prevention: Migration/integration test for FK and invalid SEASONAL/EXPIRABLE rows.

issues.title: No typecheck script, no CI, and tsc is polluted by the Vitest HTML report
issues.evidence: No typecheck/audit scripts; no GitHub Actions; tsc reads generated html/ vitest assets.
issues.remediation: Add typecheck with exclude for html/coverage/dist; minimal GHA: install, lint, typecheck, test.
issues.prevention: CI on default branch so unused locals / type errors cannot merge.

issues.title: processOrder logs the full order on every request
issues.evidence: console.log(order) dumps nested products (names, stock, dates) to stdout; Fastify logger unused.
issues.remediation: Remove order dump; structured orderId log via Fastify logger if needed; wire LOG_LEVEL.
issues.prevention: Lint ban on console.log under controllers/services.

issues.title: Test database setup interpolates the DB path into a shell command
issues.evidence: child_process.exec with `--url=${databaseConfig.url}` / databaseName allows shell metacharacters from env.
issues.remediation: Use execFile (no shell) or drizzle API / better-sqlite3 schema push without shell.
issues.prevention: Review check that setup does not shell-interpolate env paths.

issues.title: Several direct dependencies are unused
issues.evidence: No src import of lodash, dayjs, object-hash, app-root-path, @fastify/error, @fastify/under-pressure, pino, pino-pretty among others.
issues.remediation: Remove unused runtime deps; move leftover @types to devDependencies.
issues.prevention: knip/depcheck in CI after ISSUE-016.

issues.title: Dead ids array and unnecessary non-null assertions fail baseline checks
issues.evidence: Unused `ids` fails tsc noUnusedLocals; xo fails on two unnecessary `order!` assertions.
issues.remediation: Delete ids; drop unnecessary assertions; re-run xo and tsc.
issues.prevention: typecheck + lint in CI (ISSUE-016).

issues.title: Names and doubled test-file suffixes obscure the order flow
issues.evidence: myController / dbse / ps naming; helpers named database-tools.ts.ts and unit-test-setup.ts.ts; drizzle plugin comment says Prisma.
issues.remediation: Rename controller/locals/helpers after behavior tests exist; fix Prisma comment.
issues.prevention: xo naming + reject `*.ts.ts` filenames.
